info.description: Updates a user's profile in AWS CodeStar. The user profile is not project-specific. Information in the user profile is displayed wherever the user's information appears to other users in AWS CodeStar.
info.title: AWS CodeStar

requests.description: Adds an IAM user to the team for an AWS CodeStar project.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=CodeStar_20170419.AssociateTeamMember
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_CODESTAR_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates a project, including project resources. This action creates a project based on a submitted project request. A set of source code files and a toolchain template file can be included with the project request. If these are not provided, an empty project is created.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=CodeStar_20170419.CreateProject
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_CODESTAR_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates a profile for a user that includes user preferences, such as the display name and email address assocciated with the user, in AWS CodeStar. The user profile is not project-specific. Information in the user profile is displayed wherever the user's information appears to other users in AWS CodeStar.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=CodeStar_20170419.CreateUserProfile
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_CODESTAR_API_KEY}} with your API key | Set Content-Type to multipart/form-data for file uploads | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Deletes a project, including project resources. Does not delete users associated with the project, but does delete the IAM roles that allowed access to the project.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=CodeStar_20170419.DeleteProject
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_CODESTAR_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Deletes a user profile in AWS CodeStar, including all personal preference data associated with that profile, such as display name and email address. It does not delete the history of that user, for example the history of commits made by that user.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=CodeStar_20170419.DeleteUserProfile
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_CODESTAR_API_KEY}} with your API key | Set Content-Type to multipart/form-data for file uploads | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Describes a user in AWS CodeStar and the user attributes across all projects.

requests.description: Removes a user from a project. Removing a user from a project also removes the IAM policies from that user that allowed access to the project and its resources. Disassociating a team member does not remove that user's profile from AWS CodeStar. It does not remove the user from IAM.

requests.note: Replace {{AWS_CODESTAR_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
